client_log_dir.description: Directory where Amanda client logs and temporary files are stored.

lockfile_dir.description: Directory where Amanda writes lockfiles to prevent concurrent operations.

client_name.description: Hostname or FQDN by which the Amanda server will refer to this client (must match server configuration).

client_port.description: TCP port on which the Amanda client daemon (amandad) listens for incoming connections.

use_tcp_wrappers.description: Enable or disable TCP wrappers access control for amandad connections.

tcp_wrappers_file.description: Path to the TCP wrappers configuration file (usually /etc/hosts.allow).

compress.description: Compression algorithm to use for backup streams. Options: none, fast, best, gzip, lzo, bzip2.

max_tps.description: Maximum tape write speed in KB/s (0 = no limit). Use to avoid saturating disk or network I/O.

hold_tape.description: If enabled, the client holds the tape after backup instead of rewinding and ejecting.

disks.description: List of filesystems to back up. Each entry defines mount point and options.

mount_point.description: Absolute path of the filesystem to back up (e.g., /home, /var/log).

comment.description: Optional human-readable description of this disk.

trust.description: Security trust model: 'client' (server trusts client) or 'dumper' (client authenticates to dumper).

index.description: Whether to generate index entries for this disk.

backup.description: Backup method: 'find', 'dump', 'star', or custom script path.

bump.description: Behavior when bump conditions are met (e.g., skip, next, error).

bump_days.description: Skip further backups after this many days since last successful backup.

bump_size.description: Skip further backups after this many MB of data added since last full backup.

bump_total_size.description: Skip after this total MB backed up since last full backup.

bump_total_days.description: Skip after this total number of days backed up.

max_bumps.description: Maximum bump events before erroring out.

max_size.description: Maximum size (in MB) of this disk to back up. Larger disks are skipped.

max_total_size.description: Total size (in MB) across all backups before skipping.

max_total_days.description: Total days backed up before skipping.

priority.description: Priority for scheduling: low, medium, high.

taper_algo.description: Algorithm for writing to tape: single, full, increment, etc.

taper_max_size.description: Maximum size (MB) allowed on tape before switching.

taper_min_size.description: Minimum size (MB) to consider a tape full.

taper_scan_size.description: Amount of data to scan to determine tape usage.

taper_scan_time.description: Maximum time (seconds) to spend scanning the tape.

taper_switch_size.description: Size (MB) threshold to trigger tape switch.

taper_switch_time.description: Time (seconds) threshold to trigger tape switch.

taper_wait_time.description: Seconds to wait before retrying tape operations.

taper_write_speed.description: Target write speed (KB/s) for this disk.

taper_write_speed_target.description: Target write speed (KB/s) for dynamic throttling.

taper_write_speed_window.description: Time window (seconds) for averaging write speed.

tapes.description: List of physical tape devices to configure (optional for disk-to-disk setups).

comment.description: Optional description of this tape device.

label.description: Labeling scheme: auto, none, or custom string.

driver.description: Driver type: auto, scsi, atapi, or custom command template.

rewind.description: Whether to rewind the tape after operations.

rewind_after.description: When to rewind: all, none, or list of operations.

skip_blocks.description: Number of blocks to skip at start of tape (e.g., for tape labels).

sparse.description: If true, write sparse files to avoid filling tape with zeros.

strict_eod.description: If true, fail on incomplete tape write (avoid corrupting tapes).

tape_label.description: Label prefix for tapes written by Amanda.

tape_type.description: Tape format type: LTO, DAT, VXA, etc. (affects compression and block size).

write_protect.description: Write protection handling: none, hardware, software.

extra_options.description: List of additional configuration lines (for unsupported or advanced settings).
